kind: observed aggregate (EPRI DPQ II sag statistics, monitored 2000s) + explicit assumptions

units.rate: events per year at a site

transmission.note: medians (not means: mean 31-115% above median per EPRI); sag counts exclude events > 1 min

substation.note: medians (not means: mean 31-115% above median per EPRI); sag counts exclude events > 1 min

feeder.note: medians (not means: mean 31-115% above median per EPRI); sag counts exclude events > 1 min

sampling.method: site rate multiplier m ~ LogNormal(0, sigma); annual count per bin ~ Poisson(m * bin_rate); depth uniform within bin (assumption)

assumptions_not_from_data.duration: NOT IN EPRI REPORT (EPRI: duration follows protective-device clearing). Grounded on ERCOT evidence (PDCWG Nov 2024 large-load deck): normal clearing 3-4 cycles; delayed clearing from breaker failure 10-19 cycles. Default mixture (weights ASSUMED): 90% normal clearing 3-5 cycles, 10% delayed clearing 10-20 cycles. ITIC/SEMI vs SARFI80 gap is the only duration signal in the data (transmission: 30% of sags below 80% fall inside the ITIC envelope).
assumptions_not_from_data.phases: NOT IN EPRI REPORT. Phase count (1 vs 3) must be assumed; ERCOT 2024 large-load deck reports SLG faults causing larger load reductions than modeled for shallow positive-sequence dips.
assumptions_not_from_data.transfer: EPRI sites are US distribution-system sites; ERCOT/Texas lightning, line length and local grid strength not represented (EPRI prediction equations need site parameters not available here).

limitations: Aggregate site statistics, not raw events; no joint depth-duration-phase distribution
Dataset from early-2000s DPQ II monitoring; grid and loads have changed
Transmission group has N=53 sites; Texas not isolated
Depth bins derived by differencing cumulative SARFI medians (medians do not strictly add)
